ewb.cancelMessage: The bill will be withdrawn from the portal. Goods already in transit must not move against a cancelled bill.
ewb.urpHint: URP if the party is not registered
ewb.raiseFailed: The bill could not be raised
ewb.ruleOdc: Over-dimensional cargo gets one day per 20 km, or part thereof.
ewb.ruleRegular: One day per 200 km, or part thereof.
ewb.extendFailed: The bill could not be extended
ewb.cancelFailed: The bill could not be cancelled
ewb.partBIntro: Part-B records each leg of the journey. Add an entry whenever the vehicle changes — a breakdown, a transhipment, or a fresh carrier.
ewb.extendIntro: The new validity is worked out from the distance still to cover, not the original journey, and counted from now.
ewb.cancelIntro: A bill can be cancelled within 24 hours of being raised, and only if it has not already been verified in transit. This one can be cancelled until {{deadline}}.
ewb.historyEmptyBody: Part-B updates and extensions appear here.
ewb.ruleUpdates: It updates as you change the distance or the cargo.

einv.payload: The payload sent to the portal
einv.cancelledOnPortal: This IRN was cancelled on the portal.
einv.cancelFailed: The IRN could not be cancelled
einv.cancelWarning: Cancelling withdraws the reported invoice from the portal. It cannot be undone, and the document number cannot be used again this financial year — raise a fresh invoice instead.

gstr1.notWholeMonth: The range above isn't one whole month. A return is filed for a month.
gstr1.emptyTableBody: No document in the selected period falls into it.
gstr1.hsnNote: Quantities and values rolled up by HSN, as table 12 of the return wants them.
gstr1.nilNote: Table 8 — nil-rated, exempted and non-GST supplies.
gstr1.docsNote: Table 13 — documents issued in the period, by numbering series.
gstr1.advancesNote: Table 11 — GST on advances for services: 11A, received and not yet invoiced in the period; 11B, earlier advances invoiced in it.
gstr1.summaryHint: Open a section to see what it holds.
gstr1.openDocumentHint: Open a document to see it in full.
gstr1.rateSummaryNote: Every rate across B2B, B2CL, B2CS, EXP, CDNR and CDNUR, net of credit notes.
gstr1.amendNote: Amendments — documents of earlier filed returns changed since (B2BA, B2CLA, EXPA, CDNRA, CDNURA), and B2CSA by original month. A cancelled one is reported again at nil.
gstr1.emptyAmendBody: Nothing filed earlier has changed. Amendments show when the range is one month.

gstr2b.claimAskBody: The matched bills' input tax credit ({{amount}}) is booked for this period. Lines still to review aren't claimed.
gstr2b.uploadHint: Or upload the JSON or Excel file from the GST portal (Returns → GSTR-2B → Download).
gstr2b.noSessionHint: This GSTIN isn’t connected to the GST portal. Download GSTR-2B there (Returns → GSTR-2B → Download, JSON or Excel) and upload the file here.

gstr2b.nothingYet: No GSTR-2B for this period yet

gstr2b.totalsNote: Check “All lines in 2B” against the portal’s own GSTR-2B summary. Bills not in 2B are your bills, not in the total.

challan.title: GST challan
challan.hint: Record a GST deposit (PMT-06) as the challan shows it. It moves the money from your bank into the GST cash ledger; the set-off then pays tax from there.
challan.pickBank: Pick the account it was paid from
challan.cpinInvalid: The CPIN has 14 letters and digits
challan.noAmount: Enter what was paid under at least one head

utilization.title: Utilization entry
utilization.hint: Set off the period’s GST: tax from the GSTR-3B data, paid from credit in the order the law sets and the rest from the GST cash ledger. Reverse charge, interest and late fee are paid in cash only.
utilization.outputMismatch: Output tax in the books does not match the return
utilization.outputMismatchBody: The Output ledgers carry a different amount for this period than GSTR-3B says is owed (forward and reverse charge). Check for documents dated in another month or journals posted to Output by hand before you set off.
utilization.oldRcmOpen: {{amount}} of reverse charge from before November 2026 is still open; you can pay it from the cash ledger here.
utilization.existingHint: A period is set off once. Reverse this entry to record it again.
utilization.reverseAskBody: The GST journal for this set-off is deleted, and the credit and cash it used are free again. You can post the set-off afresh.
utilization.rcmCash: Reverse charge of {{amount}} is paid in cash, in full.
utilization.short: The GST cash ledger holds too little. Record a challan first.
utilization.resetPrefill: Start again from the suggested set-off
